title_en: The night the lights went out
setting_ko: 아침에 이웃 벤이 어젯밤 정전 이야기를 해요

lines.en: Jiwoo, what were you doing at ten last night?
lines.sp: Jiwoo, what wer ya doin' at ten las' night?
lines.hk: Jiwoo, 왓 워려 두인 앳 텐 래스 나잇?
lines.ko: Jiwoo 씨, 어젯밤 10시에 뭐 하고 있었어요?

lines.en: I was sleeping on the sofa. Why?
lines.sp: I wuz sleepin' on the sofa. Why?
lines.hk: 아이 워즈 슬리핀 온 더 쏘파. 와이?

lines.en: The lights went out on our floor at ten!
lines.sp: The lights wen' out on our floor at ten!
lines.hk: 더 라잇츠 웨나웃 온 아워 플로어 앳 텐!

lines.en: Really? I didn't notice. I was dreaming!
lines.sp: Really? I didn' notice. I wuz dreamin'!
lines.hk: 륄리? 아이 디든 노우리스. 아이 워즈 드리민!

lines.en: Lucky you. My kids were sleeping, so we talked quietly.
lines.sp: Lucky you. My kids wer sleepin', so we talked quietly.
lines.hk: 러키 유. 마이 키즈 워 슬리핀, 쏘 위 톡트 콰이엇리.
lines.ko: 부럽네요. 아이들이 자고 있어서 저희는 조용히 이야기했어요.

lines.en: Was it dark for a long time?
lines.sp: Wuzzit dark fer a long time?

lines.en: About an hour. We were having dinner when the lights went out.
lines.sp: Aboud an hour. We wer havin' dinner when the lights wen' out.
lines.hk: 어바우런 아워. 위 워 해빈 디너 웬 더 라잇츠 웨나웃.
lines.ko: 한 시간쯤요. 저녁 먹고 있는데 불이 나갔어요.

lines.en: Oh no. What were you eating?
lines.sp: Oh no. Wha' wer ya eatin'?

lines.en: Pancakes. The last ones were half-cooked, but I ate them anyway!
lines.sp: Pancakes. The las' ones wer half-cooked, bud I ate 'em anyway!
lines.hk: 팬케익스. 더 래스 원즈 워 해프 쿡트, 버라이 에잇 엄 애니웨이!
lines.ko: 팬케이크요. 마지막 것들은 반쯤 익었지만 그냥 다 먹었어요!

drill.prompt: Jiwoo, what ____ doing at ten last night?
Really? I ____ notice. I was dreaming!
